fusions.name: Drift Net
fusions.desc: Sweeps a net through a cone 2.5 tiles long, dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave each target [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tear Along the Seam
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up, dealing 9 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Shroud
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Shagreen Lining
fusions.desc: 10% of the damage that reaches you is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
